name: idx_decisions_bot_time
sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_decisions_bot_time
    ON decisions(bot_name, created_at)

name: idx_fills_symbol_time
sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_fills_symbol_time
    ON fills(symbol, filled_at)

name: idx_orders_status
sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_status
    ON order_intents(status, created_at)

name: idx_positions_account_time
sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_positions_account_time
    ON position_snapshots(broker, account_ref, observed_at)

name: audit_events
sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    bot_name TEXT,
    correlation_id TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    details_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)

name: bot_runs
sql:
CREATE TABLE bot_runs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    bot_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    finished_at TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    details_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)

name: broker_orders
sql:
CREATE TABLE broker_orders (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    intent_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES order_intents(id),
    broker TEXT NOT NULL,
    broker_order_id TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    submitted_at TEXT,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    response_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    UNIQUE (broker, broker_order_id)
)

name: capital_buy_reservations
sql:
CREATE TABLE capital_buy_reservations (
        request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        bot TEXT NOT NULL, account_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
        config_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        amount_total TEXT NOT NULL,
        state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('HELD','UNKNOWN','CLOSED')),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

name: capital_verified_states
sql:
CREATE TABLE capital_verified_states (
        bot TEXT NOT NULL, account_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
        config_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        reconciliation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        funded_capital TEXT NOT NULL,
        eligible_cash TEXT NOT NULL,
        position_cost TEXT NOT NULL,
        realized_net_profit TEXT NOT NULL,
        baseline_pending_buy_commitment TEXT NOT NULL,
        as_of TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(bot,account_ref),
        FOREIGN KEY(reconciliation_id) REFERENCES reconciliation_runs(id)
    )

name: dashboard_control_requests
sql: CREATE TABLE dashboard_control_requests (request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, response_json TEXT NOT NULL)

name: dashboard_control_state
sql: CREATE TABLE dashboard_control_state (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), revision INTEGER NOT NULL, state_json TEXT NOT NULL)

name: decisions
sql:
CREATE TABLE decisions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    bot_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
        decision IN ('BUY', 'SELL', 'HOLD', 'BLOCK')
    ),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    strategy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    rationale_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)

name: fills
sql:
CREATE TABLE fills (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    broker TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_ref TEXT,
    broker_fill_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    broker_order_id TEXT,
    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    side TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (side IN ('BUY', 'SELL')),
    quantity TEXT NOT NULL,
    price TEXT NOT NULL,
    fee TEXT,
    currency TEXT,
    filled_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    raw_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    UNIQUE (broker, account_ref, broker_fill_id)
)

name: independent_bot_configurations
sql:
CREATE TABLE independent_bot_configurations (
            bot TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            config_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

name: independent_config_requests
sql:
CREATE TABLE independent_config_requests (
            request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            response_json TEXT NOT NULL
        )

name: manual_execution_requests
sql:
CREATE TABLE manual_execution_requests (
            request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            bot TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            response_json TEXT,
            error_type TEXT
        )

name: market_snapshots
sql:
CREATE TABLE market_snapshots (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    bot_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    price TEXT,
    currency TEXT,
    data_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    source_verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (source_verified IN (0, 1))
)

name: order_intents
sql:
CREATE TABLE order_intents (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    bot_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    broker TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_ref TEXT,
    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    side TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (side IN ('BUY', 'SELL')),
    quantity TEXT NOT NULL,
    order_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CREATED',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    decision_id INTEGER REFERENCES decisions(id),
    metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)

name: position_snapshots
sql:
CREATE TABLE position_snapshots (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    broker TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_ref TEXT,
    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity TEXT NOT NULL,
    average_cost TEXT,
    market_value TEXT,
    currency TEXT,
    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    raw_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)

name: price_samples
sql: CREATE TABLE price_samples (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, symbol TEXT NOT NULL, price TEXT NOT NULL, sampled_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

name: reconciliation_runs
sql:
CREATE TABLE reconciliation_runs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    broker TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_ref TEXT,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    finished_at TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    discrepancies_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
)

name: risk_checks
sql:
CREATE TABLE risk_checks (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    decision_id INTEGER REFERENCES decisions(id),
    bot_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    passed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (passed IN (0, 1)),
    checked_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    rules_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    reasons_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
)

name: audit_events_no_delete
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER audit_events_no_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON audit_events
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit events are append-only');
END

name: audit_events_no_update
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER audit_events_no_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_events
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit events are append-only');
END
